what: Docker CPU (4 threads), 12 questions x 2 rounds per configuration (first request of each configuration excluded, n=23), median seconds. STT (~3 s) is the earlier measurement, unchanged and not re-measured here. Machine was shared with a training job, so absolute values are inflated; compare configurations only.
script: scripts/measure_latency.py via a docker compose override per configuration
caveat: llm_assist was reported available in every run (Ollama on the host); its calls are inside the ask time and add noise when the host GPU is busy.
